The '''airship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. This ship belonged to the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] based on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatist]] attack on Dantooine, it was used by the Jedi to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and head for [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
